description: Shared frame of the DocumentEditor developer debug modals (redesign DE-2.1): a centered modal dialog named by its Title with a scrim, a header with an optional Copy button (rendered only when OnCopy is bound), a Close button, a focus trap and the sections placed in ChildContent. TmDocumentJsonDebugModal and TmDocumentClipboardHtmlDebugModal are thin wrappers over it; their data-testid contract is unchanged.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Modal title; it is the visible heading and the dialog's accessible name.

parameters.name: ModalTestId
parameters.description: Unprefixed test id of the dialog root (resolved through TestIdPrefix).

parameters.name: CloseTestId
parameters.description: Unprefixed test id of the close button. No test id when omitted.

parameters.name: CopyTestId
parameters.description: Unprefixed test id of the copy button. No test id when omitted.

parameters.name: OnCopy
parameters.description: Raised when the user asks to copy the payload. The copy button is rendered only when a handler is bound.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the modal should close (close button or backdrop).

examples.title: Debug modal with one section
examples.code:
<TmDocumentDebugModal IsOpen="_open" Title="Payload" ModalTestId="payload-modal" OnClose="() => _open = false">
    <TmDocumentDebugSection Title="Body" SectionTestId="payload-body" ContentTestId="payload-body-content" Content="@_json" />
</TmDocumentDebugModal>
